dedupe_keys.name: env18 local authority collected waste annual results england waste collected recycled and disposed of by each council since 1996 97

description: These tables report how much waste every council in England collects each year and what happens to it, the standard source for recycling rates and residual waste tonnages by local authority. They are published by the Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs from the quarterly returns councils make to the WasteDataFlow system. Coverage is England, its regions and each waste collection and disposal authority, with annual spreadsheets from 2005-06 to 2023-24 and historical tables of household recycling by material back to 1996-97. The tables give local authority collected and household waste generated, the tonnages recycled, composted or reused, sent to energy recovery or landfill, recycling rates and residual waste per household, together with a carbon metric report. All files are available as a free download in OpenDocument, Excel or CSV form under the Open Government Licence. Caveats: the page is marked historical, formats and table layouts change between years, collection and disposal authorities report different parts of the flow in two-tier areas, and commercial waste collected by private firms is excluded. Simulation uses: setting the tonnage each authority sends into collection, sorting, energy-from-waste and landfill in waste network and capacity models, and testing scenarios such as higher recycling targets. Related records: the Environment Agency waste operations register (data-ea-waste-operations-permit-register) lists the facilities that receive this waste, and Eurostat municipal waste (data-eurostat-env-wasmun) gives the national totals for comparison.
name: ENV18 local authority collected waste annual results (England): waste collected, recycled and disposed of by each council since 1996-97
provider: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs (Defra), from WasteDataFlow returns
schema_summary: Per local authority, region and England and financial year: local authority collected waste and household waste generated, recycled, composted and reused, sent to energy recovery, landfilled and otherwise managed, recycling rates, residual waste per household; historical tables of household recycling by material and region (1996-97 to 2009-10) and a carbon metric

sources.note: ENV18 statistical data set, first published 8 November 2012, last updated 31 March 2026 (2023-24 data added): final annual results for local authority collected waste and management figures for England; ODS files per year from 2021-22 to 2023-24 (1.9 MB local authority and regional spreadsheet), CSV datasheets for 2015, XLS from 2005-06 to 2011-12, household recycling by material and region April 1996 to March 2010, England carbon metric report; contact WasteStatistics@defra.gov.uk; Open Government Licence v3.0
